definitions.region: Periodic connected cells at or above current min+0.5*(max-min); flat contrast<=1e-12 gives zero
definitions.amplitude_qualification: Current contrast >=0.1 of initial basal contrast, at each endpoint
definitions.initial_exposure: Amplitude-qualified initial frame with exactly one half-contrast region and defined local circular centre
definitions.centre: Circular centre weighted by primary-current minimum inside the connected region; valid if local phasor magnitude/weight sum >1e-6
definitions.outcome: At endpoint, amplitude qualification, at least one region overlapping the initial region mask, and at least one separate nonoverlapping region with defined centre in the distance bin
definitions.probability: Per initial frame and distance bin: at least one such endpoint region; several bins may co-occur. Never component count divided by frames.
definitions.bin_exposure: Initial eligible frame with a positive length of initial exterior cells in that distance bin; all such frames remain in denominator, irrespective of endpoint outcome
definitions.distance: Shortest periodic centre separation; actual initial-frame C times wrapped material-coordinate difference; initial Spring C used, endpoint stretch exported separately
definitions.undefined: Undefined initial centre excludes exposure but remains in coverage; undefined secondary centres remain explicit unresolved outcomes with lower/upper probability bounds
definitions.weighting: Per-case frame probabilities; condition means give each contributing independent case equal weight, with observed seed ranges and explicit contributor counts
definitions.cadence_sensitivity: Four largest-size f=1 standard paths: same physical lag on each of ten decimations of saved dense profiles. These are descriptive phase-sampling checks, not an extra numerical acceptance gate.
definitions.scope: Exploratory geographic endpoint concurrency only. Geographic mask overlap is not incumbent identity, birth, survival, continuous coexistence or establishment.
definitions.original_Spring_run_q90_gate: Failed and unchanged; no continuous lifetime or event rate is inferred
